support.mapping: Global Z maps to frame Y; each support line independent, no lateral response claimed
support.checks: Each axial line matches sum(P*z)/(EA); summed base reactions balance applied gravity

bridge.assumptions: Solid rectangular 8 m wide x 2 m deep illustrative elastic beam, simply supported, 12 kPa lumped area load. Diagnostic only, no strength/creep/reinforcement check.

cad.warning: Summed volumes include intentional slab/core and service-deck intersections; NOT a concrete takeoff. Roof slabs are outside indoor gross program.
